name: Daily Brief
description: Your morning in one glance — top Fox News stories, inbox highlights, and today's calendar, summarized daily and searchable in plain English.

tools.name: generate_brief
tools.description: Build today's brief now: fetch Fox News headlines, recent Gmail, and today's Google Calendar events, summarize them with the configured LLM, index everything for natural-language search, and return the brief.

tools.name: get_brief
tools.description: Return the stored daily brief — today's by default, or a specific date (YYYY-MM-DD).

date.description: YYYY-MM-DD; omit for the latest brief

tools.name: search_brief
tools.description: Natural-language search across everything the briefs have indexed: news stories, emails, and calendar events. Returns the best-matching items with kind, date, and score.

query.description: What to look for, in plain English
